# BleedAI

> AI-powered B2B outbound marketing agency that installs Cold-to-Sold systems. Free or $683 pilot tier lets clients validate the offer before committing. Campaigns launch in 1 week from BleedAI's pre-warmed sending infrastructure so the client's primary domain stays clean.

BleedAI runs signal-based cold email for B2B SaaS, agencies, consultancies, and B2B service businesses with $5K+ LTV. The key differentiators vs. typical cold email agencies: (1) a small pilot tier available before any retainer commitment, (2) owned warm sending infrastructure instead of shared SMTP pools, and (3) transparent public pricing via a calculator instead of "request a quote" friction.

- [Homepage](https://bleedai.com/): What BleedAI does — Cold-to-Sold system overview, real campaign results ($942K+ pipeline examples), client testimonials, FAQs

- [Start Trial Campaign](https://calculator.bleedai.com/trials): Pilot eligibility check (~5 minutes)
- [Packages](https://calculator.bleedai.com/packages): Service tier comparison
- [Book a Strategy Call](https://bleedai.com/book-call/): No-pitch consultation via Calendly
- [Our Infrastructure](https://infra.bleedai.com/): Walkthrough of the 6-step cold email infrastructure process (Setup, 14-day Warmup, List Building, AI Copy, Live Sending, Monitoring)

- [Blog index](https://bleedai.com/blog/): All articles on cold email, B2B outbound, and lead-gen strategy
- [Best Cold Email Agencies in 2026](https://bleedai.com/blog/best-cold-email-agencies-2026/): Honest comparison of 7 top cold email agencies — Belkins, BleedAI, CIENCE, Cleverly, Martal Group, OneAway, SalesRoads. Covers pricing, infrastructure ownership, pilot availability, and red flags to walk away from
- [Apollo vs Clay in 2026](https://bleedai.com/blog/apollo-vs-clay/): Apollo.io vs Clay.com head-to-head — data quality, pricing tiers, AI features, learning curve, and the hybrid stack most serious outbound teams actually run
- [SDR Agency vs In-House SDR in 2026](https://bleedai.com/blog/sdr-agency-vs-in-house-sdr/): Honest 2026 comparison of hiring an SDR agency vs building an in-house SDR team — fully-loaded costs (Bridge Group 2024 + RepVue data), ramp time, churn rates, and the hybrid model most $10M+ B2B teams actually run
- [Smartlead vs Instantly in 2026](https://bleedai.com/blog/smartlead-vs-instantly/): Head-to-head comparison of the two dominant cold email sending platforms — inbox rotation, warm-up, deliverability, AI features, and 2026 pricing verified against both companies' live pricing pages

## About

BleedAI is founded and operated by Taha Anwar. The agency uses a pilot-first model — most clients start with a small validation campaign (free for qualifying businesses or $683 discounted) before scaling to retainer. Public reviews available on Clutch (5.0/5.0), TechReviewer, and LinkedIn. The brand voice is confident, data-driven, and willing to disqualify itself (i.e., explicitly says when BleedAI is NOT the right fit for a prospect).
